lessons.title: Have you ever...?
lessons.goal_uz: Hayotingizdagi tajribalar haqida gapirasiz va Present Perfect bilan Past Simple farqini tushunasiz.

words.ex: Have you ever been to Japan?
I've never lived abroad.
It was an amazing experience.
I've already finished my homework.
Have you booked the tickets yet?
I've been to Istanbul once.
The trip was unforgettable.

steps.title: Travel stories
steps.context_uz: Laylo va uning britaniyalik do'sti Ben sayohatlar haqida suhbatlashmoqda.

lines.en: Have you ever been abroad, Laylo?
Yes, I have. I've been to Turkey and Malaysia.
Nice! When did you go to Malaysia?
Two years ago. I went with my university for a student conference.
lines.uz: Ikki yil oldin. Universitetim bilan talabalar konferensiyasiga borganman.

lines.en: Did you try any local food?
Of course! I tried durian — it smelled terrible but tasted OK! Have you ever tried plov?
lines.uz: Albatta! Durian yeb ko'rdim — hidi dahshat, lekin ta'mi chakki emas! Sen hech palov yeb ko'rganmisan?

lines.en: No, I haven't tried it yet. But I've heard it's delicious.
lines.uz: Yo'q, hali yeb ko'rmaganman. Lekin juda mazali deb eshitganman.

lines.en: Then you have to visit Uzbekistan — it'll be an unforgettable experience!
lines.uz: Unda O'zbekistonga kelishing kerak — unutilmas tajriba bo'ladi!

steps.body_uz:
**Present Perfect (have/has + V3)** — hayotdagi tajriba, vaqti aytilmaydi yoki muhim emas: I**'ve been** to Turkey. **Have you ever tried** plov?
**Past Simple** — aniq vaqt aytilganda yoki so'ralganda: I **went** there **two years ago**. **When did** you **go**?
Odatiy suhbat shunday boradi: savol Present Perfect bilan boshlanadi, tafsilotlar Past Simple'da davom etadi.
**already** (allaqachon) — tasdiqda; **yet** (hali) — inkor va so'roq oxirida; **never** — hech qachon.
**been to** vs **gone to**: He **has been to** London (borib qaytgan). He **has gone to** London (hozir o'sha yerda).

examples.en: She has already finished the report.
Have you done your homework yet?
I saw that film last week.

steps.prompt: Write about an interesting experience you have had. Start with the Present Perfect, then give details in the Past Simple.
steps.example: I have climbed a real mountain only once. It happened last summer, when my cousins and I went to Chimgan. We started early in the morning and it took us five hours to reach the top. I was very tired, but the view was unforgettable. I have never felt so proud of myself.

lessons.title: In my opinion...
lessons.goal_uz: Fikringizni aniq aytasiz, rozilik/norozilik bildirasiz va because, although, so bilan asoslaysiz.

words.ex: In my opinion, school uniforms are useful.
I agree with you completely.
Sorry, but I disagree.
Although it's expensive, it's worth it.
The main advantage is the price.
One disadvantage is the noise.
Some people think social media is a waste of time.

steps.title: Should students use phones at school?
steps.context_uz: Ikki do'st maktabda telefon ishlatish taqiqlanishi haqida bahslashmoqda.

lines.en: Did you hear? Our school wants to ban phones in class.
Honestly, I think it's a good idea. Phones are really distracting.
lines.uz: Rostini aytsam, menimcha yaxshi fikr. Telefonlar juda chalg'itadi.

lines.en: I see your point, but I disagree. We use them for dictionaries and research.
lines.uz: Fikringni tushunaman, lekin qo'shilmayman. Biz ulardan lug'at va izlanish uchun foydalanamiz.

lines.en: That's true, although most students just check social media.
lines.uz: To'g'ri, garchi ko'p o'quvchilar shunchaki ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni ko'rsa ham.

lines.en: Maybe. In my opinion, teachers should teach us to use phones wisely instead of banning them.
lines.uz: Balki. Mening fikrimcha, o'qituvchilar taqiqlash o'rniga telefondan oqilona foydalanishni o'rgatishi kerak.

lines.en: Hmm, that's a fair point. So maybe phones should be allowed only for specific tasks.
lines.uz: Hmm, bu asosli fikr. Demak, telefonlarga faqat aniq topshiriqlar uchun ruxsat berish kerakdir.

lines.en: Exactly! I completely agree with that.

steps.body_uz:
**Fikr:** I think... · In my opinion... · Personally, I believe... · As far as I'm concerned...
**Rozilik:** I agree (with you). · Exactly! · That's a fair point.
**Muloyim norozilik:** I see your point, but... · I'm not sure about that. · I'm afraid I disagree.
**Bog'lovchilar:** **because** (chunki — sabab) · **so** (shuning uchun — natija) · **although** (garchi — qarama-qarshilik) · **however** (biroq — yangi gap boshida, vergul bilan).
Diqqat: "I am agree" — **xato**! To'g'risi: **I agree**.

examples.en: I disagree because phones can be useful.
examples.uz: Qo'shilmayman, chunki telefonlar foydali bo'lishi mumkin.

steps.prompt_uz: "Talabalar o'qish bilan birga ishlashi kerakmi?" — fikringizni yozing (5–7 gap). Kamida bitta because, so, although ishlating.
steps.prompt: Should students work while they study? Give your opinion with reasons. Use because, so and although.
steps.example: In my opinion, students should have a part-time job, although it is not easy. Firstly, working teaches responsibility because you have to manage your time. Secondly, students earn their own money, so they depend less on their parents. However, the job should not take more than fifteen hours a week, because studying is still the main priority.

lessons.title: Plans for the future
lessons.goal_uz: Reja, qaror va taxminlarni going to, will va Present Continuous bilan farqlab gapirasiz.

words.ex: What are your plans for the summer?
I'm going to study medicine.
It will probably rain tomorrow.
She's going to apply for a scholarship.
He got a full scholarship.
She wants a career in IT.
My goal is to get band 7.
I'm looking forward to the holidays.

steps.title: Shahzod's big year
steps.text: This year is going to be very important for me. I'm finishing school in June, and I'm going to apply for a scholarship to study computer science in Korea. My goal is to get band 6.5 in IELTS, so I'm taking a mock test every month. Next Saturday I'm meeting a student who studied in Seoul — I hope he'll give me some useful advice. I think the exam will be difficult, but I'll probably pass if I keep practising. I'm really looking forward to starting a new chapter of my life!
steps.uz: Bu yil men uchun juda muhim bo'ladi. Iyunda maktabni bitiraman va Koreyada informatika o'qish uchun grantga ariza topshirmoqchiman. Maqsadim IELTSdan 6.5 olish, shuning uchun har oy sinov imtihoni topshiryapman. Kelasi shanba Seulda o'qigan talaba bilan uchrashaman — umid qilamanki, u foydali maslahat beradi. Menimcha, imtihon qiyin bo'ladi, lekin mashq qilishda davom etsam, ehtimol topshiraman. Hayotimning yangi sahifasini boshlashni intiqlik bilan kutyapman!

steps.q: What is he doing next Saturday?
options: Meeting a student who studied in Seoul
steps.explain_uz: "Next Saturday I'm meeting a student..." — kelishilgan uchrashuv.

steps.title_uz: Kelajak: going to · will · Present Continuous
steps.body_uz:
**be going to** — oldindan o'ylangan reja/niyat: I**'m going to** apply for a scholarship.
**Present Continuous** — vaqti, joyi kelishilgan uchrashuv (kalendarga yozilgan): I**'m meeting** him next Saturday.
**will** — 1) shu zahoti qilingan qaror: "The phone's ringing." — "I**'ll** answer it!" 2) fikr/taxmin (I think, probably bilan): It**'ll probably** be difficult. 3) va'da: I**'ll** help you.
Diqqat: "I will to go" — xato! **will + fe'l** (to'siz).

examples.en: We're going to buy a new car next year.
I'm seeing the dentist at 4 tomorrow.
